name: gooo-workflows
description: Instructions for a small Gooo source edit and for comparing a selected MCP tool definition in saved before/after pages. Uses local native tools prepared separately.

interface.longDescription:
Use two existing workflows: edit a small .gooo program and retain its execution/replay observations, or compare a selected MCP tool definition in saved before/after tools/list pages. The snapshot workflow reports observed changes and page coverage; it does not prove compatibility or authorize tool calls.

Gooo language and compiler: https://github.com/kimjooyoon/meta-ontology-go

Requires a local desktop thread on macOS or Linux. Native setup follows the included skills and is separate from this instructions-only package. No compiler, Go toolchain, native executable, MCP server, or account connection is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Use gooo-first-program to edit the tutorial and show its new execution and replay.
Use gooo-compare-tool-snapshots to compare my saved before/after MCP pages.
